title: Law to track and report noise near seaplane bases
summary: This bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection to install sound level meters on city buildings and, upon request, private buildings within 600 feet of seaplane bases. The department would have to post monthly reports of decibel readings, including time, location and sound level, on its website starting one year after the law takes effect. The law would take effect 90 days after it becomes law.
